claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as a fast-paced first-person shooter featuring a high skill ceiling, movement mechanics, and weapon variety.

citations.review_text:
ULTRAKILL is an action-packed fast paced first person shooter that hits the ball out of the park as fast as it's own gameplay. Genuinely some of the most fun I have ever had playing a shooter like this.

The art style, sound design, sound track, mechanics, story, everything, it's all done so well and makes great company for the thrilling mechanics and combat.

10/10. I sometimes just use 10/10 for games I personally love a lot but this is quite literally borderline perfect. Can't wait to see how the story ends, great work Hakita.

Oh, one more thing, mankind is dead, blood is fuel, hell is full.
Excellent game on all fronts. Very fast-paced, tactile & intuitive gameplay with a high skill ceiling, sick BGM and artstyle, et al.

claims.claim: Reviewers report performance issues and frame drops specifically on the Fraud layer or later parts of the game.

citations.review_text: Fraud layer laggy as hell, the loop parts in 8-1 and that yellow store in 8-2

Overall Great Game 

If your looking for a fast paced boomer shooter where you can turn your enemy's into a fine red mist THIS is the game for you my friend!

The main and only real issue are the performance issues ESPECIALLY with FRAUD'S release but all of that has (mostly) been Fixed! But still i would look out if you have older hardware in the later layers.

Overall, this is a fantastic game which is great to play. It has a high skill ceiling, and the fast-paced combat mixed with positioning really does challenge my brain. However there are still a couple of things about this game that i would like to see improved. If you do not want spoilers about the content of this game, then do not read the remaining paragraphs of this review, just know that there's a lot of jank in the game beyond what should realistically be there for a game whose next patch is supposed to be release patch.

First off, the latest major patch, fraud, has caused a lot of new bugs to be added while also making the game run like a slideshow on act III. I understand that hotfixes and but patches were put out to fix these issues, but i still clip out of bounds far too much for me to call it playable, especially when trying to P rank a level.

Additionally, the enemy AI needs to be reworked. While this was planned to be released with fraud, as far as i can tell from the publisher's discord server, there was no AI rewrite included in the fraud release of the game other than to add compatibility with portals. There have been many times where enemy AI's seem to magically turn off, leading me to go on a goose chase to find the last stray or filth who randomly decided to stop thinking for the day. Additionally, some enemies like swordsmachines can't seem to navigate the terrain in Cybergrind well at all, resulting in them making circular journeys around the arena just from me jumping, when they could realistically jump off the ledge themselves, or do an attack and still hit the player while on top of the ledge.

Lastly, the amount of niche information in this game is far too much. There's things like disabling a mindflayer's teleportation using a screwdriver, dealing increased damage to insurrectionists via oiling them, being able to use rockets on a maurice through oiling them, and many other niche interactions. While the enemy interactions are written…

It isn't finished, my frames drop at layer 8, not a casual experience, plays more like Devil May Cry than a Boomer Shooter. I can't recommend this to everyone, especially those who get motion sick, but if you are up for playing a very unique FPS, you should try it.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game includes multiple difficulty options, allowing players to lower the challenge if they struggle.

citations.review_text:
A friend gifted me this game, and yeah it's ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ AWESOME! The game has a lot of difficulty options so if you're ever struggling you can always go down to one of the easier difficulties and have little trouble.

If you're dedicated to get good enough to play through the hardest difficulty, you can also pull off really awesome gameplay! There's a whole host of mods and custom levels to install too, if you get tired of the base game stuff. 

Only issues I can think of is the lag in some late parts of the game, and also the game isn't good at giving you information about techniques you can do to aid you in gameplay... also a lot of people like backseating and giving you unsolicited advice so beware of the fandom at times.

[h3] I regret not wasting money on this, - feels like having sex with a prostitute instead of getting an actual partner, - the easier but shameful way to get pleasure. [/h3]

This game can give you the pleasure of sex, but without actually being sexual - that is a rarity nowadays. You can be ridiculously bad at FPS games, but still be able to play it normally without rage quitting, as it contains a bunch of difficulty levels ranging from absurdly easy to its absolute opposite. You can always feel yourself like a man-army by alone fighting hundreds of demons, angels and husks. Huge accessibility, it's never a bad thing. 
That doesn't stop there, but gets even better with all the atrocious ♥♥♥♥ you can do with all the weapons and their variations, - you can perform wild combos and use techs with some being as simple as a press of 2 buttons, and some requiring extreme caution but paying off heavily. And that's not even a requirement to play like this, - you can play in any simple way you want. It will affect your style points, but it's not like it matters. There's more ♥♥♥♥ I like and would write about such as music, characters, etc., but that's too much for a review and might contain spoilers, who likes them?

[h3] Conclusion: ULTRAKILL feels like sex without any actual sexuality in it but no less pleasure. That's why the people from its community like to make so much gay-sex jokes. [/h3]

ULTRAKILL. The best gameplay of any game ever. I cannot recommend it enough, not only is the game awesome, so are the developers and even the publishers. If you enjoy fast past shooters, this game is easily accessible with the easier difficulties, and the skill celing is insanely high. Just buy the game. It's incredible. Buy it, you know you want to. (and you should)
